caption: Longer-range missile model phase 4: dynamic trajectory selection, height-aware friendly interception, and per-profile gravity. Player archers lob a volley over a friendly heavy infantry regiment directly between shooter and target. Dynamic trajectory solving elevates the ballistic arc to 46.5 wu of height at the friendly line, clearing the 40.0 wu (2.0 m) clearance threshold and passing cleanly overhead without friendly interception, leaving the friendly line unharmed while striking the enemy.
